visualCharacteristics.purpose: Radio toggle that switches page content between audiences (domestic / international, individuals / organisations)

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: single cell label (e.g. 'Showing information for'). Rows 2+: cell 1 = option label (e.g. 'Domestic students'), optional cell 2 = audience key (defaults to slugified label). Sections with section-metadata 'Audience: <key>' (or elements with class audience-<key>) show only for the selected audience.
